Supply Chain and Procurement · the home page in three looks

The first tool of the Financial domain. The layout is the same as every Hospital Operations tool: the rail, the header, the page and the chat panel sit in the same places, and the page keeps its five zones in the same order. What changes is the domain’s identity: the type families, the shapes, the paper, the marks, and how the rail, header and chat are dressed. Pick a look below. Scroll inside each view; the chat stays one screen tall with its own scroll. Every page opens with its first part raised and its box open. Tap another part to raise it instead.
